method_note: Every row assigned supply_tier in {product, framework, primitive}. product = a runnable application delivering the capability end to end (own UI, data model, identity/permissions, workflow); framework = a substrate you build a product of that kind on (packages/ + examples/ monorepos, mountable engines, starter templates); primitive = a library/SDK/engine implementing part of the capability with no UI, identity or workflow of its own. Primary signal was the existing composite_contents structural field (ui + data + host_chrome => product; no ui => primitive) plus reuse_shape_recommendation. 44 of 200 rows were decided by a live `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents` read this pass, spent on rows where the structural fields were genuinely ambiguous — chiefly the e_sign and calendar_scheduling rows that motivate this pass, and the CMS/admin-framework boundary (packages/+examples/ monorepo => framework, app dir + migrations + docker-compose => product). The remaining rows were decided from fields already present. Licence class and disposition were NOT re-derived; they are carried unchanged from the survey lane. clean_* counts require license_class in {permissive, permissive-open-core} AND disposition == candidate AND the stated tier. The 'was' baseline in kinds_whose_classification_changed is the tier-blind read this pass replaces: counting every permissive+candidate row as supply regardless of whether it is runnable.
